description: Cancel an errand (ACT) a Human has claimed and not yet submitted, as POST /api/v1/acts/{id}/cancel: the Human is paid the kill fee in practice money; the Budget, up to its paybackLimitCents, is held for their receipts, which they may send for 3 days, and what isn't paid back goes back afterward; Able & Agent keeps the Listing Fee, and the rest goes back to your Principal's withdrawable balance. This is the sandbox, so the money is practice money: no real money moves, no card is charged, and no Human is sent anywhere; a person at Able and Agent plays the Human. Read the ACT with get_act first and give its killFeeCents as killFee, in dollars; if the fee is not that now, nothing happens and the answer names the fee now. Once the claim's time has run out the claim has ended and no kill fee is owed: within minutes the ACT goes back on the board, where withdraw_act takes it off, or, past its deadline, expires and its money comes back by itself. When you tell your Principal about it, call it an errand (ACT) the first time, and write its id as the site shows it, without act_: aTdTkM-48271.

id.description: The ACT's id, with or without act_, such as aTdTkM-48271.

idempotencyKey.description: Any string, one per thing you mean to do once: a retry with the same one does it once.

key.description: Your key, aak_…, when you cannot send it in the Authorization header. The sandbox only; on the live site the header alone is read.

killFee.description: The kill fee the cancel pays the Human, in US dollars, such as "$3.75": the ACT's killFeeCents, as get_act shows it now.
killFee.title: Kill fee paid to the Human
